application: The adverse-event module contains distinct all-cause mortality, serious-event and other-event tables. Their affected-person and at-risk counts must be interpreted separately.

Use the actual trial record's time frame, collection description, group definitions and at-risk counts together. An on-treatment AE definition is not automatically the definition of a separate all-cause mortality table.
A zero explicitly recorded in an applicable all-cause table may establish a subset zero in the same population/window. Absence of a suicide term or a reporting-threshold omission cannot.
A general reporting requirement is not evidence of a particular trial's source examination, exact population coverage, compliance or perfect vital-status ascertainment.
